༄༅/ /yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying thig dang*/'phags ma'i snying tig gi gtor ma'i pra khrid 'chi med 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying thig dang*/ 'phags ma'i snying tig gi gtor ma'i pra khrid 'chi med 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//a mṛ taṃ dzñā na swa yaṃ bhū gu ru nirma kā ā yu tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje tshe dpag med/ /bde chen ye shes tshe sbyin 'phags ma yum/ /gtsug tor las skyes bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal/ /rnam gsum tshe yi lha der gus phyag 'tshal/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus sgrub pa'i rten/ /rten mchog 'chi med snying po 'khyil ba'i dpal/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal lung bdud rtsi mchog /mchog tu dngas shing dad pas 'di na spel/ ji skad du/ o rgyan tshe dpag med pa'i zhal nas/ las rnams kun gyi thog ma ni: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa bya: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mtho ris yon tan bdun gyi phyi mo/ chos sgrub pa'i rten mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i snod du gyur pa/ rdo rje'i lus yun ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs lhur len dgos pas na/ rdo rje'i sngags rgyud rnams nas tshe sgrub pa'i thabs tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo gtso bor gyur pa'i 'chi med tshe lha rigs gsum gcig tu bsdus te sgrub pa'i cho ga rgya che ba sa yi gter dang*/ zab mo dgongs pa'i gter zung du 'brel ba nyid kyi sgrub rten gtor ma'i de nyid mdo tsam 'chad pa la gnyis/ rnam bzhag spyir bstan pa/ lag len bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/ kun rdzob brda'i dbang du byas na/ sngags kyi kun spyod khyad par dang 'brel ba gang zhig /dam tshig gi rdzas la brten nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi bye brag go /don dam rang bzhin yongs shes dbang du byas na/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi khyad par can mtshon par byed pa nyid de/

/gnyis pa la/ thun mong gi dbang du byas na ba la stobs bskyed pa la'o zhes pa'i byings don la drangs te/ sngags kyi dam tshig khyad par can gyi ye shes kyi stobs bskyed par byed pa'am/ khyad par gyi dbang du byas na/ rgyud las/ bha ni yig 'bru bha ga ste/ li ni yig 'bru liṅga mtshon pas thabs dang*/ zhes pa ltar gtor ma'i skad dod ba liṃ zhes pa'i sgras/ bha ga mtshon pas shes rab dang*/ li'i sgras liṅga mtshon pas thabs dang*/ thig le dang gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa sbyor ba'i mtshon pas/ dbang bzhi'i lam dang sbyar na/ thabs gsal ba lha'i 'khor lo/ /shes rab zab mo stong pa nyid do/ zab gsal dbyer mi phyed pa'i lha sku snang stong zung 'jug bum dbang gi lam/ de bzhin du thabs rlung dang gtum mo la brten pa'i bde ba dang*/ shes rab drangs pa'i mi rtog pa dbyer mi phyed pa gsang dbang gi lam/ thabs rdo rje nor bu dang*/ shes rab phyag rgya'i pad+ma'i reg bya'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dga' ba bzhi dang*/ stong bzhi'i 'od gsal dbyer mi phyed pa dbang bzhi lam mtshon par byed pa sogs rgya cher bshad du yod do/ /smra brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ zab gter gyi gsang ba rnams las/ chos nyid gzhi'i gtor ma/ rang rig lam gyi gtor ma/ dbyer med 'bras bus gtor ma gsum gyi rgyun don thams cad bsdus pa'i tshul dang*/ gzhan yang snod bcud gtor ma'i mchod pa/ phung po gtor ma'i mchod pa/ srog dbugs gtor ma'i mchod pa/ rnam rtog gtor ma'i mchod pa sogs dbye sgo mang du yod kyang*/ re zhig sgrub pa lag len dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas na/ sgrub pa'i gtor ma/ mchod pa'i gtor ma/ las sbyor gyi gtor ma gsum du 'du ste/ dang po ni/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi sgrub gtor lta bu gnyis pa ni/ sman raka gtor gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i gtor ma lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ zor du 'phang ba'i gtor ma lta bu'o/

/khyad par snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung rnams las/ gtor ma gcig la shes pa gsum mam bzhi ldan du gsungs pas/ sgrub pa'i dus su lhar shes pa/ mchod pa'i dus su 'dod yon du shes pa/ dbang dang dngos grub dus su byin rlabs su shes pa/ 'phang ba'i dus su nad mtshon du shes pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin la gom pa brtan pos dmigs pa bstan na 'dod rgur bsgyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa lag len bye brag tu phye ba la sa gter tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba'i yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying tig gi sgrub gtor chen mo 'chi med dngos grub 'khyil ba dang*/ dgongs gter 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi tshe gtor 'chi med snying po ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /de la'ang bzhi/ gtor ma'i rgyu/ mtshon don/ lag len gtan la phab pa/ dgos ched bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshe zhes pa rjen 'thag dang*/ gal zhes pa chang gi nying khu cung zad dang*/ mar zan la snying po lnga bsres nas bca' ba ste/ sa gter gter gzhung las/ dbyings las rang shar 'chi med mchod sdong che: chos dbyings khyab pa chen po'i mkha' klong du: lhun grub snying po lnga yi rgyu las grub: ces gsungs pa ltar/ snying po lnga ni/ rnam 'joms 'grel ba las/ sa yi snying po til/ chu yi snying po lan tshwa/ rtsi thog snying po mar/ shing thog snying po bu ram/ me tog snying po sbrang rtsi dang lnga'o/ /de la'ang sa'i snying po gser du bzhed pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ mar dang 'o ma lan tshwa dang*/ bu ram sbrang rtsi snying po lnga/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir gser dang 'o ma dag legs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ yum lnga'i rang bzhin bang rim sra brtan la: thig le rang shar rig ma bcu drug gnas: zhes pa ni/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ste 'byung lnga bskyed rim gyi yum lnga'i klong du/ ri rab bang rim bzhi brtsegs shar dkar lho sngo nub dmar byang ser/ de steng pad 'dab phyi dkar dmar bcu drug gi steng ze'u 'bru dmar ser grangs med bkod pa ni/

gzhung las thig le 'bum phrag 'chi med grong gi tshogs: rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la rab tu gnas: zhes pa'i don te/ de steng rnam rgyal khang bzang sogs ni/ gzhung las/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin rnam rgyal khang bzang la: rin chen lnga yi rgyan gyis mdzes par spras: phyag brnyan tshe yi lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: dbang gi lha mo mthar byed tsaṇ+ḍa li: dgos dgu 'jo ba chos sku'i bum pa bzang : zla gam 'bar ba mi 'gyur gong bu'i phyug: thig le phyag mtshan lnga yi dra ba 'phyang : dpag bsam sdong po yal 'dab ut+pal rgyas: 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'bras bzang char du bsnyil: yid bzhin nor bu zur brgyad rgyan dang ldan: zla gam dmar po rta mgrin phag mo yum: nyi zla'i dbu rgyan ye shes me dpung 'bar: zhes pas mtshon te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ cha tshad sogs spyir bshad pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ dang po ni/ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi rten gang la'ang*/ rgyud lung man ngag dang 'brel ba gang zhig /mthong na mi mthun pa med pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zhig dgos te/ ji skad du/ mig yul dag la ma mdzes na/ /cha tshad bzo bas ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang*/ cha tshad mkhas na bzo yi rgyal po yin/ /thig gdab mkhas na bzo yi blon po yin/ /ri mo mkhas na bzo yi btsun mo yin/ /lag len mkhas na bzo yi 'bangs 'khor yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtor ma'i dpe'u ris su thig gdab pa ltar cha tshad nges par bya zhing mchod rten la'ang bri cha legs kyang 'bur du grub tshe legs min 'byung ba ltar phyag rgyun sogs dpyad la gzab par bya dgos so/ /gom shes phyag gi gom khrid dang*/ dpyad shes rig pa drung ldan dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos grub 'khyil pa dang*/ 'chi med snying po'o/ /dang po ni/ 'og nas rim bzhin mthing*/ ljang*/ dmar/ dkar/ ser po ste bang rim zlum po lnga brtsegs mtshams pa'i steng gru bzhi bzhi brtsegs kyi steng phyogs rnams g.yer kha dang bcas pa/

de steng pad 'dab bcu drug zlum bskor/ de steng gru bzhi glo 'bur can/ de steng zlum bskor glo 'bur dang mnyam pa/ de steng tshe ril phreng tshar gsum sogs gang 'os kyi dbus su/ tshe bum lhung bzed 'dra bzhag ste gzer zhing brtan par bya/ bum pa'i khar rin chen cha brgyad/ thabs shes zla gam bcas cha tshad 'os par bya/ bum pa'i kha rgyan phyogs bzhir shing lo bzhi/ bar mtshams bum pa'i chun 'phyang la nor bu/ zla gam steng rdo rje/ nyi zla me ri sogs dpe'u ris dang*/ kha byang ltar ma 'khrul bar bya'o/ /zhar byung rten gtor sogs la gtor ma'i nang du gzung 'bul ba sogs phyag len du mdzad cing gal shin tu che ba yang yin la/ de'i rnam bzhag cung zad brjod na/ dang po chos kyi ring bsrel gzungs sngags gzhugs pa'i tshul ni/ ya mtha' rdo rje'i lte ba nas ma mtha' bang rim 'og ma'i bar/ srog shing gser dngul lam zangs dang snyug ma'i sbu gu lta bu'i nang du gzhugs pa'am/ yang na mar zan lta bu la/ lha shing shar rtags dang rtsa rtse ma nor ba'i srog shing spyi 'gros ngos gser gyi bri ba'am/ mthing shog la gser gyis bris nas dkris kyang rung gang ltar yang 'bri bya'i sngags ni/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab gzhal yas khang dang bcas par/ so so'i rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags la bskyed pa rkyen gyis sngags sbyar ba nyid 'bri ba skabs su bab pa yin te/ bskyed bya bskyed byed kyi 'brel grub pa'i phyir/ des na nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mtshon pa'i bang rim 'og mar/ e ā kā sha maṇ+ḍa la/ des mtshon te rlung dkyil gyi thad du/ yaṃ wā yu maṇ+ḍa la/ me dkyil la/ raṃ dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la/ chu dky-il la/ baṃ u da ka maṇ+ḍa la/ sa dkyil la/ bh+rūm̐ bhu mi maṇ+ḍa la/ ri rab la sum su me ru dang rten snying*/ pad 'dab bcu drug la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang spro na mchod pa'i sprin gzungs/ gzhal yas khang la/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shūd+dhe dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/

zhes dang*/ spro na nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs/ deng sang yongs grags 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi gzungs/ oṃ bi pu la sogs 'di yin/ phyogs mtshams so so'i phyogs gcig tu byas kyang rung ste ha badz+ra kiṅka ra ā yur+dzñā na bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ri rat+na kiṅka ra = ni pad+ma kiṅka ra = sa karma kiṅka ra = baṃ tsaṇ+ḍa li ā yur+dzñā na = bum par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐/ tā re tut+tā re sarba ta tha ga ta ā yur+dzñā na ma hā puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭha oṃ zhes dngos grub bskyil ba'i sngags ci mang gzhugs rin chen zur brgyad la/ stabs bde na dbus su sgrol ma'i yig bcu/ shar du/ oṃ tā re tām̐ swā hā: lhor/ oṃ tā re bh+rūm̐ swā hā: nub tu/ oṃ tā re hrī swā hā: byang du/ oṃ tā re hūm̐ swā hā: mtshams bzhir shar lho nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ hūm̐ badz+ra ha ya gṛ wa ha: trām̐ rat+na ha ya gṝ wa ri: hrīḥ pad+ma ha ya gṛ wa ni: aḥ karma ha ya gṝ wa sa: slar yang shar gyi phyi rol nas brtsam ste g.yas bskor du/ oṃ tā re tām̐ dzaḥ shin+taṃ ku ru swā hā: oṃ tā re bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: oṃ tā re hrīḥbam̐ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ oṃ tā re hūm̐ ho: ma ra ya phaṭa: zhes so sor shog dril byas nas gzhugs pa'am/ ma bde na phyogs gcig tu bris kyang rung*/ nyi zla'i gwa'u nang du/ oṃ bud+dha ha ya gṝ wa bud+dha wā ra hi bam̐: de'i steng du/ oṃ a mṛ ta a yur da dā+e swā hā: rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+te ye swā hā: oṃ bud+dha a yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ oṃ: oṃ pad+ma ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hrī: oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ rat+na ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ tram̐: oṃ karma ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ aḥ zhes dang*/ tshe dpag med kyi gzungs ring*/ yar gyi rwa dang pad+ma'i thad rtsam du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dha ra ā yur+dzñā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bri/ de ni gzungs gzhugs rgyas par bri ba'i tshul yin la/ bsdu na 'byung lnga sogs sa bon tsam dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sngags tshang ma 'khor rnams sa bon tsam bri bas mtshon gtor ma'i che chung sogs la dpag ste rig pas dpyad shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos sku'i ring bsrel bla ma gong ma tshe'i dngos grub mnyes pa rnams kyi gdung tshwa'i ring bsrel dang*/ gsum pa yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel 'phags pa gsum gyi gdung sku gdung ring bsrel bla ma gong ma tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa rnams kyi gdung gi cha shas/ bzhi pa sku bal gyi ring bsrel/ dbu skra na bza' sogs dang*/ thun mong du tshe ril/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ bdud rtsi ril bu sogs byin can sel med rnams dar thum du byas te rin chen zur brgyad dang*/ nyi zla'i kha sbyor sogs kyi nang du ci rigs par gzhug par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyas par 'byung ba rim brtsegs mtshon pa'i zan leb zlum po ljang gu'i steng*/ ri rab bang rim bzhi mdog sngar bzhin/ de steng gzhal yas khang mtshon pa'i rin chen zur brgyad dkar po nor bus mtshan cing drwa phyed kyis mdzes pa/ de steng gdan nyi zla mtshon pa'i zan leb zlum po/ dbus sgrol ma dkar mo'i mtshon byed tshe 'brang bum gzugs ril bus bskor ba'i khar/ tshe dpag med mtshon pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mar gyi rwa tshe bum gyi phyogs bzhir zug pa/ mtshams bzhi na kha rgyan 'phyang ba/ rdo rje'i rtse mor gtsug tor rnam rgyal mtshon byed nyi zla nor bu 'od zer gyi pa tra dang bcas pa'o/ bzhi pa dgos ched la/ dngos dang 'phros don no/ dang po ni/ sa gter yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying thig gi dbang dang sgrub chen gyi skabs su tshe gtor 'chi med dngos grub 'khyil pa 'di nyid med du mi rung ba nyid de/

dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dngos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ gter gzhung las/ rin chen dpal be 'od kyi drā ba ru: tshe bdag zhi khro yab yum bcu drug bzhugs: steng 'og rgya gram yi ge lu gu rgyud: thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor gwa'u'i klong : gzhom gzhig med pa stobs bcu'i rdo rje 'bar: yar gyi rwa la o rgyan tshe dpag med: man+dha ra ba yum bcas rig 'dzin 'khor: mar gyi rwa la tshe bdag rnam rgyal ma: lte bar dwangs ma lnga ldan thig le ru: 'chi med rgyal po lnga dang btsun mo lnga: rang byung gdod ma'i dbyings las shar ba'i sku: bar khyams phyi rol thig le thig phran la: bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs: ma lus spro zhing bsdu ba'i bdag nyid can: nyi zer rdul ltar mkha' khyab 'khor lor rdzogs: sangs rgyas drug gi dkyil 'khor chen po la: 'bum dang bye ba sa ya dung phyur sogs: bsam yas zhing las sku dang ye shes dang : yon tan mdzad pa phrin las mtha' mi mngon: dam tshig ye shes gdod nas dbye ba med: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgyan du rdzogs: zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ gnyis pa 'phros don ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab bang rim sogs la rgya tshad ma bshad pa ci zhe na/ 'gal ba med de mchod rten gyi skabs su'ang/ sa 'dzin yid dang mtshams pa'i steng*/ ces pas mtshon rgya tshad mdzes cha dang bstun te dpyad chog pas na ma smos pa yin no/ /gtor ma la thig sogs mi 'thad do zhe na/ shin tu 'thad de lha dang gzhal yas khang yin pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/ gtor ma lha yi gnas gsum nas: sogs dang gtor ma rin chen gzhal yas khang : zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ rten 'brel rdzas la nus pa sngags/ /zhes pa ltar sgrub pa'i rten rdzas med du mi rung ba yin pas na tshul dang mthun pa gal che'o/ gsar ma'i rgyud rnams las ma bshad do snyam na/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las/

mngon spyod la ni gru gsum ste/ /zhi ba la ni gru bzhi pa/ /zhes gtor ma'i dbyibs bcas gsungs pa mkhas grub snga ma rnams kyis bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /smras pa/ kun bzang smon lam klu dbang gis bskul bas/ /kun khyab khrus khang lha yi rdzing ring las/ /gtor tshogs shes pa bzhi ldan sprin phung 'khrigs/ /'chi med tshe g.yang dngos grub bcud du 'khyil/ /pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying*/ /mdo sngags zung 'jug snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog /gling bzhi'i dbus na ri dbang ltar brjid par/ /mi 'gyur mi shig rtag brtan lhun grub shog /kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /'od zer dpag med shin tu rnam nges pa/ /gzi brjid rgyal po'i ngo bor 'tsho gzhes shing*/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i phrin las mthar phyin shog /shākya seng ge'i lung gis rab bsngags shing*/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdzod la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /mchog gter zab gsang chos kyi bdag po kun/ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i ngo bor zhabs brtan gsol/ /mdor na phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ /'jig rten khams kun rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod/ /mthar thug mchog dngos 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rnams gnyis dang*/ lo chen rin po che blo gros mtha' yas sogs dam pa mang po'i zhabs rdul gtsug tu theb pa'i rtags kyi 'dul 'dzin ban rgan karma rat+nas bla ma'i zhal lung thob pa dang gtor dpe 'dra bsdus sogs gung spros nas bris pa bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ maṅga laṃ/ ༈ /yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying thig gi sgrub gtor dngos grub 'khyil ba'i thig rtsa bzhugs so/ /oṃ swā sti sid+dhi/ /bla ma 'chi med tshe yi lha/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub gtor dngos grub 'khyil ba yi/ /bzo nyes 'gog pa'i cha tshad la/

/mchod rten dkyil 'khor thig rtsa ltar/ /cha chen gcig la cha phran bzhi/ /g.yas g.yon lnga lnga sdom pas bcu/ /gyen du bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'am/ /yang na bzhi bcu rtsa dgu gdab/ /ri rab bang rim phyogs bzhi ru/ /ril bu nor dbyibs brgyad re bkod/ /sdom pas mtshan bzang so gnyis grangs/ /bang rim lnga la phyogs mtshams su/ /ril bu dmar ser bcu re bkod/ /dpe byad brgyad cu'i grangs ldan 'byung*/ /'od khyim rmug la zlum kor gsum/ /me tog 'dab bzhi bkod pa'am/ /yang na mar thig grangs med bya/ /'byung rim ri rab rigs pas dpyad/ /cha tshad rnam bzhag rags pa'o/ /zhib par 'bur du bskrun pas shes/ /mthong ba don chub pra khrid lags/ /de la thog mar dpangs kyi cha la me ri cha phran gsum/ nyi ma la cha phran gnyis/ zla ba cha phran gcig /gser rdor cha phran bzhi/ thabs shes zla gam cha phran bzhi/ rin chen cha brgyad cha phran bzhi/ bum pa'i khar 'phyang cha gnyis/ mgul cha gcig /lte ba'i dpangs cha bzhi mthong zhing*/ ril bu 'og tu cha gsum 'gro kha pad cha gcig /gzhal yas khang cha bzhi/ pad+ma ze'u 'bru bcas cha gsum/ ri rab bang rim bzhi la cha re re ste bzhi las ma byas kyang rung la/ yang na gnyis re ste brgyad byas na legs/ 'byung lnga la re re/ 'phred du cha phran gdab pa gzhal yas khang gi tshad dang*/ glo 'bur la cha re 'bur bas bcu ste tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon du cha phran lnga re dor ba'o/ /gzhan rnams rigs pas dpag nas shes par bya'o/ /dza yan+tu// //
